facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: hazard report during cleaning and preparation on P-4102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.
Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-4102, ACC-4102 and HX-4120 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. P-4102 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 27 November 2013 a hazard report was recorded on P-4102, ACC-4102 and HX-4120 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during cleaning and preparation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
